Automate your thank you messages across email and SMS with Omnisend’s free plan Start free today See pricing Quick sign up | No credit card required Why do “thank you for your business” messages matter? Thank you for your business messages matter because a kind note can turn a one-off purchase into a repeat customer. Plus, the cost of sending this note is minor. Yet it shapes how people see your brand. Three things tend to happen when you do it well. First, customers are more likely to stay loyal when they feel valued, and a thank-you is a great way to show appreciation. Attentive surveyed 3,300 shoppers and found that 44% name feeling appreciated as what sets their favorite brands apart: Feeling valued outranks price and preferences, so a simple thank you for your business message does competitive work. Image via Attentive. Second, happy customers bring you more customers. In that same Attentive survey, two-thirds of shoppers said they recommend brands they love to friends and family: The most common act of loyalty is a referral, which is exactly what a well-timed “thank you for your business” message encourages. Image via Attentive. That word of mouth reaches people no ad can, and it costs you nothing. Third, the thank-you note shapes how your brand is perceived. A quick and well-timed thank-you note reads as human. This is where automation can help. Omnisend’s 2026 email benchmarks show automated emails convert at 1.49%, compared with 0.08% for one-off campaigns. A thank you message runs as an automation, so it lands in that stronger group. 40 “thank you for your business” messages Here are 40 thank you for your business messages, grouped by the moment that prompts each one. Find the group that matches your situation, copy the message, then swap the brackets for your own details. Every message works as a “thank you for your business” template you can send as-is. They fit an email footer, an SMS, a packing slip, or the bottom of an invoice. Also, they work for any customer at any stage.
